card.headline: al riyadi lift the *dubai* title.
status: Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall, Dubai

highlight.text: The winning margin in an all-Lebanese final.

caption:
Al Riyadi are champions of the Shabab Al Ahli International Basketball Championship in Dubai. 🏆

They beat Antonin 95-76 in an all-Lebanese final on Wednesday night at the Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall.

Two Lebanese clubs in a final abroad, three days before the new Lebanese league season tips off on Saturday. Congratulations to both. Who impressed you most in Dubai? 🇱🇧

Source: Grand Lebanon, IMLebanon
@alriyadiclub @flb_official
#SportsWireLB #LebaneseBasketball
alt: Result card: Al Riyadi 95, Antonin 76, final of the Shabab Al Ahli International Championship at the Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall in Dubai, Wednesday 21 October. A 19-point winning margin in an all-Lebanese final.

facts.claim: Al Riyadi beat Antonin (Club Antonin Sportif, Baabda; FLBB spelling "Antonin") 95-76 in the final of the Shabab Al Ahli International Basketball Championship on Wednesday 21 October 2026 at the Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall (Al Mamzar, Dubai); Al Riyadi are champions; margin 19 points
Al Riyadi are from Beirut; Antonin are from Baabda
The Lebanese basketball league (FLBB first division) 2026-27 season starts on Saturday 24 October 2026, three days after 21 October
The club's name is spelled Antonin by the FLBB
House spelling 'Al Riyadi' follows FIBA ('Al Riyadi Beirut Club') and the club itself (riyadi.com), per sources/spelling.md (basketball = FIBA spelling); the FLBB site writes 'Riyadi'
